versions.changelog:
- Initial release of auth0-express skill for adding authentication to Express.js apps using express-openid-connect.
- Provides step-by-step setup for login, logout, and protected routes with session-based authentication.
- Includes troubleshooting tips, common mistakes and fixes, and links to further documentation.
- Highlights when to use (or not use) this integration and lists related skills for different frameworks and use cases.
